nodes.name: BackupManager.php
nodes.summary: Filament admin page that lists PostgreSQL backup dumps and provides actions to create, download, delete, data-only restore, and full disaster-recovery restore via the backup/db Docker containers.
nodes.languageNotes: Shells out to docker via Symfony Process; validates filenames with realpath + str_starts_with to prevent path traversal.

nodes.name: BackupManager
nodes.summary: Filament page exposing four actions (backup, restore data-only, full restore, delete) plus a download action over backup .dmp files stored on host volume.

nodes.name: getBackupFilesWithSize
nodes.summary: Returns the list of .dmp backup files with human-readable size and modification time, sorted newest-first.

nodes.name: copyToDbContainer
nodes.summary: Copies a local backup file into the database container using `docker cp` with proper shell argument escaping.

nodes.name: backupAction
nodes.summary: Filament action that runs pg_dump inside the backup container and notifies on success or failure.

nodes.name: restoreAction
nodes.summary: Restores data into existing tables by truncating then loading from the selected dump via psql in the db container; preserves schema.

nodes.name: fullRestoreAction
nodes.summary: Disaster-recovery restore: drops and recreates all tables, optionally pre-applying globals.sql, then loads the selected dump via pg_restore.

nodes.name: downloadAction
nodes.summary: Provides authenticated download of a backup dump with realpath-based traversal protection.

nodes.name: deleteAction
nodes.summary: Deletes a backup file and its sibling toc with path validation and notification.
